verdict.rationale: The evidence only says generically that "Zero Trust controls are built into the network". That is an adjacent, network-level control. Nothing in the pack shows Workers itself offering simple password protection, such as basic auth or an access gate, for a deployed site without custom auth code, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can put simple password protection on a deployed site without standing up a custom auth system

citations.quote: DDoS protection, WAF, bot management, and Zero Trust controls are built into the network and run on every request from day one.
